{{Quote|I'm a childhood friend of Leia&hellip;|Seren Song|<ref name="Star Wars (2013) 19">[[Star Wars (2013) 19|''Star Wars'' (2013) 19]]</ref>}}
'''Seren Song''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] and childhood friend of [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]. She was the daughter of the [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] delegates to the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]], who were friends with [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]]. When she was 21 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] old, she left to join the Rebel Alliance. She became a spy early on for the Alliance and spent most of her time away, without contact with Organa. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] though, Organa received a message from Song telling here to meet at the wildlife preserve planet [[Oaka Prime]]. When Song arrived, she was ambushed by the notorious droid [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[IG-88B/Legends|IG-88]]. She was saved when Organa, [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] arrived and rescued her.
